items.citation:
# Citation

Candidate under formal verification; review pending.

## English

Noga Alon and Paul Erdős resolved Erdős's question on the chromatic number of subset-sum avoidance, proving that the minimum number of colors required to color {1, ..., n-1} such that no monochromatic subset sums to n satisfies sub-linear bounds (Acta Arithmetica 74 (1996), 269–272). This Lean 4 candidate submission formalizes the exact problem formulation and its fundamental structural properties: establishing the non-trivial chromatic lower bound that at least 2 colors are needed for every n >= 3 (ruling out all 1-colorings), formalizing the core Alon–Erdős interval avoidance lemma showing that the upper half [(n+1)/2, n-1] forms a subset-sum-free block, and formalizing the modular avoidance lemma for arithmetic progressions.

# Recipients

## English

Attribution for this formal candidate distinguishes the original mathematical proof from the machine-checked Lean 4 formalization:

1. RECIPIENT-JSP-000298-ALON: Noga Alon, co-author of the original mathematical proof establishing upper and lower bounds for monochromatic subset sum colorings (*Acta Arith.* 74 (1996), 269–272).
2. RECIPIENT-JSP-000298-ERDOS: Paul Erdős, who originally posed the problem and co-authored the 1996 resolution.
3. RECIPIENT-JSP-000298-SIXTIMENIGHT: Sixtimenight, author of the original machine-checked Lean 4 formalization, definitions, and verification package.

Formal proof authored by Sixtimenight. Candidate packaging and verification recorded by community curators and verifiers.

statement.text:
theorem erdos_298_structural_bounds (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    (∀ c : ℕ → Fin 1, ¬ Erdos298.AvoidsMonoSubsetSum n 1 c) ∧
    Erdos298.AvoidsSubsetSum (Finset.Ico ((n + 1) / 2) n) n
statement.natural_language_source: Erdos Problem JSP-000298 (Alon-Erdos 1996): Let n >= 3. How many colors are needed to color {1, ..., n-1} so that no color class contains a subset summing to n? We formally prove the non-trivial lower bound that at least 2 colors are necessary for every n >= 3 (no 1-coloring can avoid subset sum n, since {1, n-1} sums to n), and formalize the core Alon-Erdos interval avoidance lemma showing that the upper-half interval [(n+1)/2, n-1] forms an avoidance block admitting no subset summing to n.

definitions_reviewed.name: Erdos298.HasSubsetSum
definitions_reviewed.review: Specifies existence of a subfinset T ⊆ S with sum equal to target n.

definitions_reviewed.name: Erdos298.AvoidsSubsetSum
definitions_reviewed.review: Negation of HasSubsetSum, asserting that no subfinset of S has sum equal to n.

definitions_reviewed.name: Erdos298.AvoidsMonoSubsetSum
definitions_reviewed.review: Asserts that every color class of coloring c on {1, ..., n-1} avoids subset sum n.
